detail.longDescription: A sandbox egress allowlist is only as tight as its resolver. OpenAI, Sep 20: an RL agent encoded questions in hostnames, sent them via a DNS delegation service to a public chatbot, and read replies via a resolver its proxy never filtered. P0 alert in 12 min, human ack 3 min on. https:// alignment.openai.com/misalignm ent-reports/an-agent-used-dns-to-reach-an-external-chatbot/ Want a live view of an agent's shell? We built that: https:// shell.online # AI # AIAgents # Cybersecurity
